summary: Polestar Automotive Holding UK PLC filed a Form 6-K on 2026-11-05 disclosing that subsidiary Polestar Performance AB lodged a conversion plan with the Swedish Companies Registration Office to convert cross-border into a Dutch B.V. under the EU mobility directive. The entity continues as the same legal person, changing registered office, legal form and governing law to the Netherlands; operations and headquarters remain in Gothenburg. Management cites a leaner holding structure and capital-structure allocation efficiency. No price, stake or board recommendation is stated; watch for creditor objections and registration timing.
